text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrives. Shinko Windy is 
splendidly chosen as the "Best Dirt 
Umamusume." And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right at the press conference, she 
declared her withdrawal! The public was 
stunned, and her prank was a massive 
success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That Shinko Windy is strong and incredible 
is already common knowledge—no award 
ceremony needed. Thus, she has no need for 
an award—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even a hundred years from now, people will 
tell tales of her. Because that was what 
she truly desired all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Shinko Windy wasn't satisfied. 
She needed to draw more attention, forge a 
legend surpassing today, and fulfill her 
grand "ambition"—!
